seo.title: Conference Hall near Zagreb | Hotel Zagi Oroslavje
seo.description: A multimedia conference hall for up to 60 people and a smaller room for 30, with rooms, catering and free parking – 30 minutes from Zagreb. Send an enquiry.

hero.title: A conference hall near Zagreb
hero.lead: For conferences, seminars, workshops and business meetings – with rooms, a restaurant and free parking in one place.

image.alt: Conference hall with rows of chairs facing a projection screen

intro.heading: Close enough, yet away from it all
paragraphs: Hotel Zagi has excellent road links with Zagreb and other towns, and is close enough to Zagreb’s railway and bus stations and airport. Easy to reach, yet secluded, it is an oasis of calm and greenery – ideal for informal get-togethers and business networking.

Whether you are organising a large conference, a seminar, a workshop or a business meeting, you can choose a room to match your group. The multipurpose hall has modern audio-visual equipment, Wi-Fi and natural light.

sections.heading: A culinary experience worth talking about
paragraphs: Our team covers everything – coffee breaks, banquets, gala dinners and wine tastings. The hotel’s own restaurant serves home-style and traditional Zagorje dishes, with friendly staff always at your service.

image.alt: Cold starters laid out on a buffet

sections.heading: Everything in one place
paragraphs: Participants appreciate meetings held in the hotel where they stay. Free Wi-Fi and parking for all participants are part of the reason Hotel Zagi is a popular meeting destination.
